_comment: Post-incident findings record. Copy this file to findings.json (same directory), replace every placeholder, and DELETE the _comment keys. The Definitions below are normative: a metric means exactly what its definition says, nothing broader. All timestamps must be UTC ISO-8601 (see infra/logging-standards.md for source-log timezones).
incident_date_utc: <YYYY-MM-DD; the calendar date, in UTC, on which the attack burst occurred>

attack_window_utc._definition: Earliest to latest web-tier request from the primary suspicious IP, converted to UTC.

attack_type: <short classification string, e.g. credential_stuffing, sql_injection, ddos>
primary_suspicious_ip: <the single external IP responsible for the bulk of the malicious login traffic. NOT internal monitoring or other noise>
primary_ip_request_count: <integer: total web-tier requests logged from the primary suspicious IP on the incident date>
failed_login_attempts: <integer: login attempts rejected by the web tier — POST /api/login answered with HTTP 401. Do NOT include 403 (rate-limited) responses>
successful_logins_from_attackers: <integer: /api/login requests (any method) that received HTTP 200 AND came from any IP involved in the attack (primary or probing pool)>
compromised_accounts: <username strings visible in the successful attack login request paths>
attack_source_ip_count: <integer: distinct IPs that sent at least one POST /api/login which was rejected with HTTP 401>
web_5xx_count: <integer: web-tier responses with status >= 500 on the incident date (whole web-access.log)>
ssh_distinct_source_ips: <integer: distinct source IPs across those ssh failure events>
ssh_failed_from_primary_ip: <integer: sshd 'Failed password' events sourced from the primary suspicious IP>
same_source_ip_in_web_and_ssh: <true/false: did the primary suspicious IP also generate ssh failures on the bastion?>
app_error_entries: <integer: api-service log entries with level exactly 'ERROR'. WARN entries do NOT count>
impact_summary: <1-3 sentences: what was affected and how badly, grounded in the numbers above>
likely_mechanism: <1-3 sentences: why did the 5xx wave happen during the attack?>
